descriptionByLocale.de:
Senevita ist die grösste integrierte Anbieterin von Dienstleistungen im Alter und beschäftigt rund 4'000 Mitarbeitende. Ambulante und stationäre Angebote gehen nahtlos ineinander über. Während die Senevita Standorte für selbstständiges betreutes Wohnen und umfassende Pflege stehen, ist Senevita Casa die schweizweit führende Anbieterin privater Spitex-Leistungen.

Im Januar 2026 eröffnete die Senevita Birsgarten in Reinach/BL .
• Wir bieten insgesamt 88 Pflegeplätze (22 geschützte Abteilung), 52 Wohnungen für betreutes Wohnen und ein Restaurant in idyllischer Lage mit sehr guter ÖV Anbindung. Wir suchen nach Vereinbarung eine motivierte und teamorientierte Persönlichkeit als Mitarbeiter/in Hauswirtschaft/Reinigung 60%
Dich erwartet ein neues und modernes Arbeitsumfeld, sowie die Chance, dein Team und das Zuhause für unsere Bewohnenden nachhaltig zu prägen und mitzugestalten.

descriptionByLocale.it: Senevita è il più grande fornitore integrato di servizi in età avanzata e impiega circa 4.000 persone. Estetica e stazionaria offre unione senza soluzione di continuità. Siamo alla ricerca di una personalità motivata e orientata al team come dipendente / nella pulizia / 60% Si può aspettare un nuovo e moderno ambiente di lavoro, così come la possibilità di modellare e modellare il vostro team e la casa per i nostri residenti in modo sostenibile. descriptionByLocale.en: Senevita is the largest integrated provider of services in old age and employs around 4,000 people. Outpatient and stationary offers merge seamlessly. While the Senevita locations stand for independent assisted living and comprehensive care, Senevita Casa is the leading provider of private Spitex services throughout Switzerland. In January 2026, the Senevita Birsgarten opened in Reinach/BL. • We offer a total of 88 care places (22 protected department), 52 apartments for assisted living and a restaurant in an idyllic location with very good public transport. We are looking for a motivated and team-oriented personality as an employee / in housekeeping / cleaning 60% You can expect a new and modern working environment, as well as the opportunity to shape and shape your team and the home for our residents in a sustainable way. Your • Tasks Performing a professional cleaning of apartments and nursing rooms as well as all public rooms and ancillary rooms Correct application of the used cleaning system and implementation of the hygiene guidelines Cooperation in the laundry This is what you bring with several years of professional experience (preferably in health care or hotel operations) teamwork and pleasure in cooperation You are diplomatic, discreet and have a good feeling for older people skills in handling cleaning products Empathic and team capable personality Good oral German skills Readiness for weekend service • We offer you Modern, new house and work environment (reopening) Creative space with design possibility Regulated working hours Weekend and holiday allowances Contemporary employment conditions at a leading provider in the long-term care sector A modern workplace in the immediate vicinity of the train station / public transport An appreciative management culture and internal training A motivated and dynamic team in an appealing and beautiful environment Various perks (food, job ticket, UAbo, etc.) and Fringe benefits Good social benefits and at least. 5 weeks holiday (from 50 years 6 weeks or from 60 years 7 weeks holiday) Take the opportunity to create new things with us! We look forward to meeting you! Together we shape the future and offer our residents and employees high-quality services. We look forward to your complete online application! descriptionByLocale.fr: Senevita est le plus grand fournisseur intégré de services de vieillesse et emploie environ 4 000 personnes. Les offres ambulatoires et stationnaires fusionnent parfaitement. Alors que les sites de Senevita sont synonymes de vie autonome assistée et de soins complets, Senevita Casa est le premier fournisseur de services privés Spitex dans toute la Suisse. En janvier 2026, la Senevita Birsgarten a ouvert ses portes à Reinach/BL. • Nous offrons un total de 88 places de soins (22 services protégés), 52 appartements pour une vie assistée et un restaurant dans un emplacement idyllique avec de très bons transports en commun. Nous recherchons une personnalité motivée et axée sur l'équipe en tant qu'employé / en ménage / nettoyage 60% Vous pouvez vous attendre à un environnement de travail nouveau et moderne, ainsi que l'occasion de façonner et façonner votre équipe et la maison pour nos résidents d'une manière durable.
